speaker: agent
text: Good morning, you are through to the broadband support team. My name is Sarah. How can I help?

speaker: customer
text: Hi Sarah. My internet keeps dropping out every evening, usually around seven o'clock.

speaker: agent
text: I am sorry to hear that. Can you tell me which lights are showing on your router right now?

speaker: customer
text: The power light is green, but the internet light is flashing orange.

speaker: agent
text: Thanks. That usually means the line is out of sync. I will run a quick test from our side.

speaker: customer
text: Okay, no problem.

speaker: agent
text: The test found some noise on the line. I can book an engineer for Thursday morning. Does that work for you?

speaker: customer
text: Thursday morning is perfect. Thank you very much.

speaker: receptionist
text: Hello, Riverside dental practice, Emma speaking.

speaker: patient
text: Hi, I would like to book a check up please. I have not been in for about a year.

speaker: receptionist
text: Of course. Could I take your date of birth and the first line of your address?

speaker: patient
text: Yes, it is the fourth of March, nineteen eighty six, and I live at twelve Mill Lane.

speaker: receptionist
text: Thank you. I have found your record. We have an appointment on Tuesday at half past two, or Friday at ten in the morning.

speaker: patient
text: Friday at ten would be better for me.

speaker: receptionist
text: Lovely. That is booked for you.

speaker: receptionist
text: We will send a reminder text the day before. Is there anything else I can help with?

speaker: patient
text: No, that is everything. Thanks, bye.

speaker: chair
text: Right, let us get started. The main item today is the release plan for the new billing system.

speaker: analyst
text: I have the numbers from last week. Error rates dropped by almost half after the patch went out.

speaker: engineer
text: That matches what we saw in the logs as well.

speaker: chair
text: Good. So are we confident enough to move the launch forward by one week?

speaker: engineer
text: I would rather keep the original date. We still need to finish the load tests on the payment service.

speaker: analyst
text: I agree. One more week of data would also make the report much stronger.

speaker: chair
text: Fair enough.

speaker: chair
text: We keep the date. Can you both send me a short summary by Friday?

speaker: analyst
text: Yes, I will have it ready by Thursday afternoon.

speaker: engineer
text: Same here. I will include the load test results if they are finished.

speaker: agent
text: Thanks for calling Swift Deliveries. Can I have your tracking number please?

speaker: customer
text: Sure, it is A B seven three nine two.

speaker: agent
text: Thank you. I can see the parcel is at your local depot. It will be delivered tomorrow before noon.

speaker: customer
text: Great. Can the driver leave it with my neighbour if I am out?

speaker: agent
text: Yes, I have added that note to the delivery.

speaker: customer
text: Brilliant, thanks.

speaker: advisor
text: You are speaking to the card services team. Before we start, can you confirm your full name?

speaker: caller
text: It is Daniel Morgan. My card was declined this morning when I tried to pay for petrol.

speaker: advisor
text: Thank you, Mr Morgan. I can see a temporary block was placed on the card because of an unusual payment overseas.

speaker: caller
text: That was not me. I have not been abroad this year.

speaker: advisor
text: Understood. I will cancel that card now and send a replacement. It should arrive within five working days.

speaker: caller
text: Will I get the money back for the overseas payment?

speaker: advisor
text: Yes, the payment will be refunded once our fraud team has reviewed it, usually within ten days.

speaker: caller
text: Okay, that is a relief.

speaker: lead
text: Morning everyone. Let us go round quickly. What did you work on yesterday and is anything blocking you?

speaker: designer
text: I finished the new sign up screens and shared them in the design channel. I am waiting on feedback from marketing.

speaker: lead
text: I will chase them today.

speaker: tester
text: I tested the password reset flow. I found two bugs, one on mobile and one with expired links.

speaker: designer
text: Is the mobile one about the button being hidden behind the keyboard?

speaker: tester
text: Yes, exactly. It only happens on smaller phones.

speaker: lead
text: Can you two pair on that this morning? I would like both bugs fixed before the demo on Wednesday.

speaker: designer
text: Sounds good to me.

speaker: tester
text: Sure.

speaker: lead
text: Great. Last thing, please update your tickets before lunch so the board is accurate for the planning meeting.

speaker: tester
text: Will do. I will also add the steps to reproduce both bugs.

speaker: designer
text: And I will attach the updated screens to the sign up ticket.

text: unreadable
